response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, avg_bytes_per_millisecond, avg_bytes_per_millisecond - (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) FROM album_rates) AS above_all_album_average FROM album_rates WHERE avg_bytes_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL ORDER BY above_all_album_average DESC LIMIT 10;
